Madras HC orders FIR in Tamil Nadu library book procurement scam

The Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court has directed the Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption (DVAC) to register a First Information Report (FIR) and freeze the bank accounts of Agal Vilakku Publications in connection with an alleged scam involving the procurement of books for public libraries in Tamil Nadu. The court noted that "crores of rupees have gone out of the public exchequer" due to irregularities in the procurement process. Reports mention alleged AI-generated books and fictitious authors in the scam, with the procurement amount cited as Rs 30 crore by one outlet and Rs 50 crore by another. The DMK party has moved the Madras High Court seeking a DVAC probe into the alleged scam.
